summary: The strict evaluator, candidate preparation receipts, hash bindings, dry-run, visual provenance, and baseline-only smoke/rollback distinctions are internally consistent. No Critical, High, or Medium defect invalidates the evidence, and all unavailable production facts remain explicitly non-claiming.

findings.message: The eight-gate evaluator is fail-closed and snapshot-isolated, including exact schemas, ordering, candidate matching, path safety, digest validation, migration ordering, and non-admission behavior.
Candidate source and migration records cross-check with the frozen artifacts; runtime projection omits secret values and records dry-run behavior without traffic, binding, or secret mutation.

Deployed smoke is explicitly baseline-only and rollback is explicitly preflight-only; pending operator acknowledgement, candidate deployment, rollback rehearsal, OAuth acceptance, Identity acceptance, release approval, and admission are accurately recorded as unproven.
The existing JPEG-byte/.png-path discrepancy is disclosed; the visual claims are limited to path, hash, dimensions, and visible content rather than PNG encoding.
